sources.title: Avianca Cargo, N330QT, Airbus A330-243F (51531118558).jpg (CC BY-SA 2.0, Anna Zvereva)
sources.note: Still in Tampa Cargo's yellow and blue on 2021-07-02: repainted red between then and 2024-12.

airframes.notes: Its red repaint lacks the scheme's swoosh and orange fillet: the aft fuselage is white up to the fin, and the rudder was paler than the fin in 2024-12. The capital 'Avianca Cargo' titles are as drawn.
airframes.status: red in its latest open photo (2024-12-14), nearly two years old; the fleet is being repainted green, so it may have changed since.
